tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground. Pulp newsprint by day, ink-black at night.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, inputs, speech bubbles. Always carries a `line` outline.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Gutters between panels, wells, code and script blocks.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunk` (16.7:1 / 14.8:1). Also outlines in paper theme.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, hints on `surface` and `surface-raised` (7.1:1 paper, 8.7:1 late-show).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: The toon outline on every card, button, field and bubble. 2-3px. Reverses to pulp at night so outlines still read.

tokens.name: shadow-ink
tokens.usage: Hard offset shadow colour behind cards and buttons. Turns scar-red at night, like the on-dark logos. Decorative only.

tokens.name: toon-red
tokens.usage: THE studio colour. Logos, display type 24px+, big fills, illustration. Never small text on pulp (4.0:1).

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill and text links. Paper: white text on it 5.9:1. Late-show: ink text on it 5.6:1.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `action` fills.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Highlights, NEW/badge fills, monogram ground, SFX lettering. Always with `ink` text (11.4:1). Never text on pulp.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Secondary illustration colour and info badges (with `ink` text). Not for text on pulp (2.5:1).

tokens.name: on-bright
tokens.usage: Text and outlines on `sun`, `sky`, `magma` and `ip-accent` fills, in both themes (5.9:1 or better).

tokens.name: scar
tokens.usage: The 'real scars' colour: mature ratings, content warnings, destructive actions, the scar mark. Text-safe on both grounds (8.1:1 / 5.4:1).

tokens.name: on-scar
tokens.usage: Text on `scar` fills.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Published / saved / live states. Teal, not green, so it never pairs with red by hue alone. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: on-success
tokens.usage: Text on `success` fills.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 3px solid focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element (5.7:1 on pulp, 9.2:1 on night).

tokens.name: magma
tokens.usage: Volcano Racers accent (IP #1). Fills and display only; on paper use `ink` text on it (5.9:1).

tokens.name: basalt
tokens.usage: Volcano Racers dark ground: hero bands, pit-lane panels. Pulp text on it.

tokens.name: ip-accent
tokens.usage: The current IP's accent. Defaults to studio red; `.tn-ip--volcano-racers` sets it to `magma`. Starfall (IP #2) gets its own value once its look is chosen.

tokens.name: on-basalt
tokens.usage: Text on `basalt` grounds (13:1+).

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per page: hero headline. Uppercase or title case.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Card titles on issue and episode pages.

styles.name: display-s
styles.usage: Small headings, card titles in grids.

styles.name: sfx
styles.usage: Sound effects, stickers, one-word callouts. Never sentences.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Ember crosses the line with a stolen heart in the passenger seat.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Art by TBD · Colours by TBD

styles.name: script
styles.sample: PANEL 1. EXT. THE CALDERA CIRCUIT - NIGHT.
styles.usage: Script excerpts, issue indicia, production metadata. Nods to how the comics are written.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon gaps, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inline gaps, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding, field gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (small), page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, grid gutters (the panel gutter).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between groups.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero padding.

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Badges, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards. Toon corners: soft, never pill-round on rectangles.

tokens.name: radius-l
tokens.usage: Speech bubbles, hero panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Rating tags and chips only.

tokens.name: shadow-toon
tokens.usage: Default hard offset shadow on cards and buttons. Never blurred.

tokens.name: shadow-toon-l
tokens.usage: Hero panels, featured issue covers, hovered cards.

tokens.name: shadow-press
tokens.usage: Pressed buttons (the element shifts 3px into its shadow).

stroke.note: Outline widths. Every object gets an ink line; that is the house look.

tokens.name: stroke-thin
tokens.usage: Inputs, badges, small chips.

tokens.name: stroke-bold
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, bubbles.

tokens.name: stroke-heavy
tokens.usage: Hero panels and logo lockups.
